title: Ramon
style: Neon retrowave / synthwave digital pop art — sunset magenta-orange gradients, cyan grid horizons, chrome, palm silhouettes. NOT photoreal. Hero likeness from reference rendered in this art style only.
story: She rides a neon night highway calling a name into the static — chrome, palm shadows, and a sunset grid that won't quit until the radio goes quiet.
